input.command:
python3 -c '
import cv2, numpy as np

img = cv2.imread("/work/observations/obs_0073.png")

# Mask terracotta pot of plant_2:
# In obs 73, plant_2 is right in the foreground
mask_pot = (img[:,:,2] > 120) & (img[:,:,0] < 80) & (img[:,:,1] < 100)
y_p, x_p = np.where(mask_pot)
if len(x_p) > 0:
    print(f"Pot 2: x=[{x_p.min()}, {x_p.max()}], y=[{y_p.min()}, {y_p.max()}], bottom_y={y_p.max()}, center_x={x_p.mean():.1f}")

# Lamp base:
# Dark circular base
mask_lamp_base = (img[:,:,0] > 70) & (img[:,:,0] < 110) & (img[:,:,1] > 70) & (img[:,:,1] < 110) & (img[:,:,2] > 70) & (img[:,:,2] < 110) & (img.shape[0] > 300)
# Let us find lamp base near x ~ 200
y_l, x_l = np.where(mask_lamp_base)
# Filter x in [170, 230], y in [340, 380]
l_mask = (x_l >= 170) & (x_l <= 230) & (y_l >= 340) & (y_l <= 380)
if np.sum(l_mask) > 0:
    print(f"Lamp base: x=[{x_l[l_mask].min()}, {x_l[l_mask].max()}], y=[{y_l[l_mask].min()}, {y_l[l_mask].max()}]")
'
input.description: Measure plant_2 and lamp in obs 73
